0.0: You're quite strong. Would you lend me your aid? I can do it myself, but there's a bit of a story... And I don't think this will be difficult at all for an adventurer like you. Are you interested?

yes.0: Wonderful. Over a decade ago, my brother Manji went into a colossal cave in the middle of this island. He discovered the Balrog, spoken of in stories and legends. Those large wings, and fangs as sharp as any blade...
yes.1: He knew he could not defeat it, and prepared for the end when it charged him. Right then, a man with a mysterious, glimmering blade appeared. The man held off Balrog long enough for Manji to escape.
yes.2: That man was the great hero, Tristan. #rMy brother got out safely thanks to him, but Tristan was wounded and fell over the cliff. My brother rushed down to find him, and saw that he was not long for this world. Tristan gave Manji the #t1302014# and closed his eyes. Now, my brother wants to restore the gladius to its original state.
yes.3: When the gladius reawakens, it will turn into the #b#t1302015##k. First, we need to purge it of Balrog's evil energy. Go to #p1061000# in #m105040300#. He'll know how.

no.0: Hah... must still hate the fact that I thought nothing of you before... You can't catch up with me with that kind of a mindset! Now I'm not so sure if I'll accept you even if you decide to change your mind... Hahaha.

1.0: This is the sword that saved my brother! What will you do? Use it, or return it to you as you promised? I'll give you a pair of valuable earrings if you give me the sword.

yes.0: Thank you for giving us your time. Maybe we'll see each other again someday.

item.0: Please reawaken Manji's #b#t1302014##k into #b#t1302015##k. #p1061000# in #m105000000# will know how. Bring it to me when you succeed and I'll compensate you well.

quest.0: Please reawaken Manji's #b#t1302014##k into #b#t1302015##k. #p1061000# in #m105000000# will know how. Bring it to me when you succeed and I'll compensate you well.

QuestInfo.name: [Sleepywood] Hero's Gladius
QuestInfo.1: You must awaken the legendary blade, Tristan's Sword, that Manji has been looking after. When it is fully awakened, it will become a #bHero's Gladius#k... Talk to #rChrishrama#k in Sleepywood.
QuestInfo.2: Chun Ji told you about the Hero's Gladius. You had to choose between the sword and Skull Earrings, but that's a pretty obvious choice.
QuestInfo.summary: Awaken the Hero's Gladius and give it to Manji.
